# subtr-actor 1.4.0 (WebAssembly build)

Rocket League replay parser used by Replay Lab, copied unchanged from the npm package
[`@rlrml/subtr-actor@1.4.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rlrml/subtr-actor) by Ivan Malison.
Source: https://github.com/rlrml/subtr-actor. License: MIT.

To update: `npm pack @rlrml/subtr-actor@<version>` and replace the two files here.
